title: Central Government Must Establish Regional Benches By Notification

content.scenario: The Central Government is planning to establish regional Benches of the National Commission. The Central Government must establish these regional Benches by notification in the Official Gazette.
content.outcome: The Central Government must establish regional Benches of the National Commission by notification in the Official Gazette.
